using Printf
const FUNCTIONS = Set(["sin", "cos", "tan", "exp", "ln", "sqrt"])
struct Form
    kind::Int
    q::Rational{Int64}
    name::String
    args::Vector{Form}
end
num(p, q = 1) = Form(5, p//q, "", Form[])
node(k, a = Form[], s = "") = Form(k, 0//1, s, a)
const ZERO, ONE, MINUS, HALF = num(0), num(1), num(-1), num(1, 2)
Base.:(==)(a::Form, b::Form) = a.kind==b.kind && a.q==b.q && a.name==b.name && a.args==b.args
Base.hash(f::Form, h::UInt) = hash((f.kind, f.q, f.name, f.args), h)
isint(f) = f.kind==5 && denominator(f.q)==1
negative(f) = f.kind==3 && f.args[2].kind==5 && f.args[2].q<0
base(f) = f.kind==3 ? f.args[1] : f
exponent(f) = f.kind==3 ? f.args[2] : ONE
function coefficient(f)
    f.kind==5 && return (f.q, Form[])
    f.kind==2 && return f.args[1].kind==5 ? (f.args[1].q, f.args[2:end]) : (1//1, f.args)
    (1//1, [f])
end
function compare(a, b)
    a.kind!=b.kind && return cmp(a.kind, b.kind)
    a.kind==5 && return cmp(a.q, b.q)
    a.name!=b.name && return cmp(a.name, b.name)
    for (s, t) in zip(a.args, b.args)
        c=compare(s, t)
        c!=0 && return c
    end
    cmp(length(a.args), length(b.args))
end
function exponent_compare(a, b)
    a.kind==5 && b.kind!=5 && return -1
    a.kind!=5 && b.kind==5 && return 1
    compare(a, b)
end
function term_compare(a, b)
    x, y=coefficient(a)[2], coefficient(b)[2]
    bs=sort!(unique(base.(vcat(x, y))); lt = (s, t)->compare(s, t)<0)
    for f in bs
        i, j=findfirst(g->base(g)==f, x), findfirst(g->base(g)==f, y)
        c=exponent_compare(j===nothing ? ZERO : exponent(y[j]), i===nothing ? ZERO : exponent(x[i]))
        c!=0 && return c
    end
    0
end
function product(c, a)
    isempty(a) && return num(c)
    c!=1 && return node(2, vcat([num(c)], a))
    length(a)==1 ? a[1] : node(2, a)
end
function add(operands::Form...)
    terms=Form[]
    for f in operands
        if f.kind==1
            append!(terms, f.args)
        elseif f.kind==2 && length(f.args)==2 && f.args[1].kind==5 && f.args[2].kind==1
            append!(terms, [mul(f.args[1], t) for t in f.args[2].args])
        else
            push!(terms, f)
        end
    end
    monomials=Vector{Form}[]
    coefficients=Rational{Int64}[]
    for f in terms
        c, m=coefficient(f)
        i=findfirst(==(m), monomials)
        if i===nothing
            push!(monomials, m)
            push!(coefficients, c)
        else
            coefficients[i]+=c
        end
    end
    built=[
        product(coefficients[i], monomials[i]) for
        i in eachindex(coefficients) if coefficients[i]!=0
    ]
    sort!(built; lt = (a, b)->term_compare(a, b)<0)
    isempty(built) ? ZERO : length(built)==1 ? built[1] : node(1, built)
end
function mul(operands::Form...)
    c=1//1
    bs=Form[]
    groups=Vector{Form}[]
    for f in reduce(vcat, [t.kind==2 ? t.args : [t] for t in operands]; init = Form[])
        if f.kind==5
            c*=f.q
        else
            b=base(f)
            i=findfirst(==(b), bs)
            if i===nothing
                push!(bs, b)
                push!(groups, [f])
            else
                push!(groups[i], f)
            end
        end
    end
    c==0 && return ZERO
    r=[length(g)==1 ? g[1] : power(bs[i], add(exponent.(g)...)) for (i, g) in enumerate(groups)]
    if any(f->f.kind in (2, 5), r) || length(unique(base.(r)))<length(r)
        return mul(num(c), r...)
    end
    product(c, sort!(r; lt = (a, b)->compare(base(a), base(b))<0))
end
function integer_root(v, d)
    v==1 && return 1
    d>20 && return nothing
    r=round(Int, v^(1/d))
    for s in max(0, r-1):(r+1)
        big(s)^d==v && return s
    end
    nothing
end
function power(b, x)
    x==ZERO && return ONE
    x==ONE && return b
    if b.kind==5
        b==ONE && return ONE
        x.kind!=5 && return node(3, [b, x])
        if b.q==0
            x.q>0 && return ZERO
            error("division by zero")
        end
        isint(x) && return num(b.q^numerator(x.q))
        if b.q>0
            s, t=integer_root(numerator(b.q), denominator(x.q)),
            integer_root(denominator(b.q), denominator(x.q))
            s!==nothing && t!==nothing && return num((s//t)^numerator(x.q))
        end
    elseif isint(x)
        b.kind==3 && return power(b.args[1], mul(b.args[2], x))
        b.kind==2 && return mul([power(f, x) for f in b.args]...)
    end
    node(3, [b, x])
end
function fn(s, a)
    s=="sqrt" && return power(a, HALF)
    a==ZERO && s in ("sin", "tan") && return ZERO
    a==ZERO && s in ("cos", "exp") && return ONE
    a==ONE && s=="ln" && return ZERO
    if s in ("sin", "cos", "tan") && coefficient(a)[1]<0
        r=fn(s, mul(MINUS, a))
        return s=="cos" ? r : mul(MINUS, r)
    end
    a.kind==4 && ((s=="exp" && a.name=="ln") || (s=="ln" && a.name=="exp")) && return a.args[1]
    node(4, [a], s)
end
variables(f) =
    f.kind==0 ? [f.name] : sort!(unique(reduce(vcat, variables.(f.args); init = String[])))
function derivative(f, v)
    f.kind==5 && return ZERO
    f.kind==0 && return f.name==v ? ONE : ZERO
    f.kind==1 && return add([derivative(t, v) for t in f.args]...)
    f.kind==2 && return add(
        [
            mul([i==j ? derivative(t, v) : t for (j, t) in enumerate(f.args)]...) for
            i in eachindex(f.args)
        ]...,
    )
    if f.kind==3
        b, x=f.args
        !(v in variables(x)) && return mul(x, power(b, add(x, MINUS)), derivative(b, v))
        !(v in variables(b)) && return mul(f, fn("ln", b), derivative(x, v))
        return mul(
            f,
            add(mul(derivative(x, v), fn("ln", b)), mul(x, derivative(b, v), power(b, MINUS))),
        )
    end
    a=f.args[1]
    h=f.name=="sin" ? fn("cos", a) :
      f.name=="cos" ? mul(MINUS, fn("sin", a)) :
      f.name=="tan" ? power(fn("cos", a), num(-2)) : f.name=="exp" ? f : power(a, MINUS)
    mul(h, derivative(a, v))
end
rebuild(f, a) =
    f.kind==1 ? add(a...) : f.kind==2 ? mul(a...) : f.kind==3 ? power(a...) : fn(f.name, a[1])
substitute(f, m) =
    f.kind==0 ? get(m, f.name, f) : f.kind==5 ? f : rebuild(f, [substitute(t, m) for t in f.args])
terms(f) = f.kind==1 ? f.args : [f]
distribute(a, b) = add([mul(x, y) for x in terms(a) for y in terms(b)]...)
function expand(f)
    f.kind in (0, 5) && return f
    a=expand.(f.args)
    f.kind==2 && return reduce(distribute, a)
    if f.kind==3 && a[1].kind==1 && isint(a[2]) && a[2].q>0
        r=a[1]
        for _ in 2:numerator(a[2].q)
            r=distribute(r, a[1])
        end
        return r
    end
    rebuild(f, a)
end
function numeric(f)
    f.kind==5 && return Float64(f.q)
    f.kind==1 && return foldl((r, t)->r+numeric(t), f.args; init = 0.0)
    f.kind==2 && return foldl((r, t)->r*numeric(t), f.args; init = 1.0)
    if f.kind==3
        u, z=numeric.(f.args)
        integral=f.args[2].kind==5 ? isint(f.args[2]) : isinteger(z)
        u<0 && !integral && error("domain error")
        return f.args[2]==HALF ? sqrt(u) : u^z
    end
    a=numeric(f.args[1])
    f.name=="ln" && a<=0 && error("domain error")
    f.name=="ln" ? log(a) :
    f.name=="sin" ? sin(a) : f.name=="cos" ? cos(a) : f.name=="tan" ? tan(a) : exp(a)
end
atomic(f) = f.kind in (0, 4) || (isint(f) && f.q>=0) || (f.kind==3 && f.args[2]==HALF)
atom(f) = atomic(f) ? show_form(f) : "("*show_form(f)*")"
show_power(b, x) = x==HALF ? "sqrt("*show_form(b)*")" : atom(b)*"^"*atom(x)
factor(f) = f.kind==1 ? "("*show_form(f)*")" : f.kind==3 ? show_power(f.args...) : show_form(f)
function quotient(c, a)
    p, q=abs(numerator(c)), denominator(c)
    top=p==1 ? String[] : [string(p)]
    bottom=q==1 ? String[] : [string(q)]
    for f in a
        if negative(f)
            r=num(-f.args[2].q)
            push!(bottom, r==ONE ? factor(f.args[1]) : show_power(f.args[1], r))
        else
            push!(top, factor(f))
        end
    end
    s=isempty(top) ? "1" : join(top, "*")
    !isempty(bottom) && (s*=length(bottom)==1 ? "/"*bottom[1] : "/("*join(bottom, "*")*")")
    c<0 ? "-"*s : s
end
function show_form(f)
    f.kind==5 &&
        return string(numerator(f.q))*(denominator(f.q)==1 ? "" : "/"*string(denominator(f.q)))
    f.kind==0 && return f.name
    f.kind==4 && return f.name*"("*show_form(f.args[1])*")"
    f.kind==3 && return negative(f) ? quotient(1//1, [f]) : show_power(f.args...)
    f.kind==2 && return quotient(coefficient(f)...)
    reduce((a, b)->a*(startswith(b, "-") ? " - "*b[2:end] : " + "*b), show_form.(f.args))
end
struct Syntax
    op::String
    args::Vector{Syntax}
    form::Union{Nothing,Form}
end
leaf(f) = Syntax("", Syntax[], f)
syntax(op, a...) = Syntax(op, collect(a), nothing)
function parse_form(text, names)
    tokens=String[]
    for m in eachmatch(r"[0-9]+|[a-z][a-z0-9]*|[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*|[-+*/^()]| +|.", text)
        t=String(m.match)
        startswith(t, " ") && continue
        !occursin(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9+*/^()-]+$", t) && error("invalid character '$t'")
        push!(tokens, t)
    end
    p=1
    peek() = p<=length(tokens) ? tokens[p] : ""
    unexpected() =
        error(p>length(tokens) ? "unexpected end of expression" : "unexpected '$(peek())'")
    function accept(s)
        peek()!=s && return false
        p+=1
        true
    end
    expect(s) = accept(s) || unexpected()
    function atom_tree()
        t=peek()
        isempty(t) && unexpected()
        if accept("(")
            a=expression()
            expect(")")
            return a
        end
        !occursin(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9]", t) && unexpected()
        p+=1
        occursin(r"^[0-9]", t) && return leaf(num(parse(Int, t)))
        if occursin(r"^[A-Z]", t)
            !haskey(names, t) && error("undefined name '$t'")
            return leaf(names[t])
        end
        !(t in FUNCTIONS) && return leaf(node(0, Form[], t))
        expect("(")
        a=expression()
        expect(")")
        syntax(t, a)
    end
    function unary()
        accept("-") && return syntax("neg", unary())
        a=atom_tree()
        accept("^") ? syntax("^", a, unary()) : a
    end
    function term()
        a=unary()
        while peek() in ("*", "/")
            op=peek()
            p+=1
            a=syntax(op, a, unary())
        end
        a
    end
    function expression()
        a=term()
        while peek() in ("+", "-")
            op=peek()
            p+=1
            a=syntax(op, a, term())
        end
        a
    end
    function evaluate(t)
        t.form!==nothing && return t.form
        a=evaluate.(t.args)
        t.op=="+" ? add(a...) :
        t.op=="-" ? add(a[1], mul(MINUS, a[2])) :
        t.op=="*" ? mul(a...) :
        t.op=="/" ? mul(a[1], power(a[2], MINUS)) :
        t.op=="^" ? power(a...) : t.op=="neg" ? mul(MINUS, a[1]) : fn(t.op, a[1])
    end
    t=expression()
    p<=length(tokens) && unexpected()
    evaluate(t)
end
variable(s) = occursin(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9]*$", s) && !(s in FUNCTIONS)
function literal(s)
    !occursin(r"^-?[0-9]+(?:/[0-9]+)?$", s) && error("invalid number '$s'")
    a=parse.(Int, split(s, "/"))
    q=length(a)==1 ? 1 : a[2]
    q==0 && error("division by zero")
    num(a[1], q)
end
const SIGNATURES=Dict(
    "SIMPLIFY"=>"e",
    "EXPAND"=>"e",
    "DIFF"=>"ev",
    "DIFFN"=>"evn",
    "GRAD"=>"e",
    "HESSIAN"=>"e",
    "IMPLICIT"=>"evv",
    "SUBST"=>"eve",
    "EVAL"=>"ea",
    "TANGENT"=>"evc",
    "LIMIT"=>"evc",
    "TAYLOR"=>"evcn",
)
function command(line, names)
    parts=split(line, " "; limit = 2)
    c=parts[1]
    arg=length(parts)==1 ? "" : parts[2]
    if c=="LET"
        pieces=split(arg, "="; limit = 2)
        length(pieces)!=2 && error("wrong number of arguments")
        s=strip(pieces[1])
        !occursin(r"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*$", s) && error("invalid name '$s'")
        f=parse_form(strip(pieces[2]), names)
        names[s]=f
        return [s*" = "*show_form(f)]
    end
    !haskey(SIGNATURES, c) && error("unknown command $c")
    fields=length(parts)==1 ? String[] : strip.(split(arg, ";"; keepempty = true))
    sig=SIGNATURES[c]
    !(c=="EVAL" ? length(fields) in (1, 2) : length(fields)==length(sig)) &&
        error("wrong number of arguments")
    a=Any[]
    for (i, s) in enumerate(fields)
        k=sig[i]
        if k=='e'
            push!(a, parse_form(s, names))
        elseif k=='v'
            !variable(s) && error("invalid variable '$s'")
            push!(a, s)
        elseif k=='n'
            !occursin(r"^[1-8]$", s) && error("invalid order '$s'")
            push!(a, parse(Int, s))
        elseif k=='c'
            push!(a, literal(s))
        else
            push!(a, s)
        end
    end
    f=a[1]
    v=length(a)>=2 ? a[2] : ""
    x=length(a)>=3 ? a[3] : ZERO
    c=="SIMPLIFY" && return ["simplified: "*show_form(f)]
    c=="EXPAND" && return ["expanded: "*show_form(expand(f))]
    c=="DIFF" && return ["d/d$v = "*show_form(derivative(f, v))]
    if c=="DIFFN"
        out=String[]
        for k in 1:x
            f=derivative(f, v)
            push!(out, "d^$k/d$v^$k = "*show_form(f))
        end
        return out
    end
    if c in ("GRAD", "HESSIAN")
        vs=variables(f)
        isempty(vs) && return ["no variables"]
        out=String[]
        for (i, s) in enumerate(vs)
            d=derivative(f, s)
            if c=="GRAD"
                push!(out, "d/d$s = "*show_form(d))
            else
                for t in vs[i:end]
                    push!(out, "d2/d$(s)d$t = "*show_form(derivative(d, t)))
                end
            end
        end
        return out
    end
    if c=="IMPLICIT"
        v==x && error("same variable")
        return [
            "d$x/d$v = "*show_form(mul(MINUS, derivative(f, v), power(derivative(f, x), MINUS))),
        ]
    end
    c=="SUBST" && return ["substituted: "*show_form(substitute(f, Dict(v=>x)))]
    if c=="EVAL"
        values=Dict{String,Form}()
        for word in split(v)
            m=match(r"^([a-z][a-z0-9]*)=(-?[0-9]+(?:/[0-9]+)?)$", word)
            (m===nothing || !variable(m[1])) && error("invalid assignment '$word'")
            q=literal(m[2])
            haskey(values, m[1]) && error("duplicate variable $(m[1])")
            values[m[1]]=q
        end
        for s in variables(f)
            !haskey(values, s) && error("no value for $s")
        end
        r=substitute(f, values)
        return [r.kind==5 ? "exact: "*show_form(r) : @sprintf("approx: %.6f", numeric(r))]
    end
    point=Dict(v=>x)
    if c=="TANGENT"
        m=substitute(derivative(f, v), point)
        y=substitute(f, point)
        z=node(0, Form[], v)
        t="tangent: y = "*show_form(add(mul(m, z), y, mul(num(-x.q), m)))
        m==ZERO && return [t, "normal: $v = "*show_form(x)]
        k=power(m, MINUS)
        return [t, "normal: y = "*show_form(add(mul(MINUS, k, z), y, mul(x, k)))]
    end
    if c=="LIMIT"
        top=Form[]
        bottom=Form[]
        for t in (f.kind==2 ? f.args : [f])
            negative(t) ? push!(bottom, power(t.args[1], num(-t.args[2].q))) : push!(top, t)
        end
        g, h=mul(top...), mul(bottom...)
        for k in 0:5
            u, b=substitute(g, point), substitute(h, point)
            b!=ZERO && return ["limit: "*show_form(mul(u, power(b, MINUS)))]
            u!=ZERO && return ["limit: unbounded"]
            k<5 && ((g, h)=(derivative(g, v), derivative(h, v)))
        end
        return ["limit: unknown"]
    end
    n=a[4]
    ds=[f]
    for _ in 1:n
        push!(ds, derivative(ds[end], v))
    end
    ps=Form[]
    fac=1
    for k in 0:n
        k>0 && (fac*=k)
        co=mul(substitute(ds[k+1], point), num(1, fac))
        push!(ps, mul(co, power(add(node(0, Form[], v), num(-x.q)), num(k))))
    end
    ["taylor: "*show_form(expand(add(ps...)))]
end
function main()
    names=Dict{String,Form}()
    for _ in 1:parse(Int, readline())
        line=readline()
        try
            for s in command(line, names)
                println(s)
            end
        catch e
            e isa ErrorException || rethrow()
            println("error: ", e.msg)
        end
    end
end
main()
